facts.content: Acute postpartum shortness of breath, query pulmonary embolism.
Tachycardia is likely secondary to SOB, pain, or anxiety.
Immediate ED referral to rule out pulmonary embolism; patient to self-transport promptly with newborn supplies and call 999 if there is deterioration.

facts.content: Patient was educated on postpartum clot risk and hospital evaluation process.
